shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side; a clear walkway runs opposite the window. A woman in a purple shirt sits at the door-side window seat and proposes a countryside holiday, while a man in a green shirt sits at the screen-end seat. There is one empty place.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the glass door end, looking along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat and the presentation screen in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a red shirt enters and sits in the empty place. She argues in favor of a sea trip instead, while the woman in a purple shirt questions if that would provide real rest.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a purple shirt explains that a sea voyage causes physical discomfort rather than recovery.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the walkway side, centered on the person at the door-side window seat.

shots.content: The woman in a purple shirt asks to choose the quiet rural destination instead.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the conference table.
